'''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V8-L-lukeskywalkertherebellionshope-2022-07-10-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V8-L-lukeskywalkertherebellionshope-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V8-L-lukeskywalkertherebellionshope-2022-07-10-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V8-L-lukeskywalkertherebellionshope.gif]], 10 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-lukeskywalkertherebe022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/lukeskywalkertherebellionshope.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/lukeskywalkertherebellionshope.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). If armed with a blaster or rifle at a site (or piloting Red 5), may add one destiny to total power or attrition. Run Luke, Run! is a Used Interrupt. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-lukeskywalkertherebe6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/lukeskywalkertherebellionshope.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/lukeskywalkertherebellionshope.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
